correctness.rationale: On a uniformly attached random recursive tree with independent edge spin signs of mean theta=2p-1, the conditional step recurrences yield mu_{m+1}=(1+theta/m)mu_m and d_{m+1}=(1+2theta/m)d_m+1 for root-aligned spin sum M_m. For q_m=mu_m-d_m/m the source derives (m+1)q_{m+1}=(m+2theta)q_m+(1-theta+theta/m)mu_m-1. The logarithmic product f_m(theta)=log((1-theta+theta/m)mu_m) is strictly concave, zeros at 0,1, giving q_m the same sign as theta for m>=3. Conditional root attachment j at time j and propagation through affine future squared-moment recurrences then yield Cov(I_j,X_n²)=(2theta/(j-1))q_{j-1} prod_{k=j}^{n-1}(1+2theta/k): zero j=2,3; strictly positive j>=4 for theta!=0, including negative theta. Summing gives c4=theta²(1-theta)/9. Negative-theta stable recursion approaches 1/(1-2theta); positive-theta telescoping with a_n~n^(2theta)/Gamma(1+2theta) gives a positive convergent C(theta); at theta=1/2 Catalan generating functions and sum H_m/[m(m+1)]=pi²/6 prove 2-pi²/6. Independently enumerated all attachment parent arrays at small n and pair-distance spin correlations, matching n4 theta=1/2 covariance 1/72; finite cases are not proofs of limits.
residual_risks: Asymptotics are for fixed interior theta, not uniform as theta approaches endpoints or zero.
